target: autonomous-auto child run identity and campaign auditability
summary: The INI-AUTO-001 Initiative Achievement Campaign reached Green, but the first fresh child reused or overlapped with older run-ledger evidence, making the campaign audit noisier than the operator experience should require.
evidence: Loop state records the fresh research child opened at 2026-04-26T13:26:53Z, while .azoth/run-ledger.local.yaml shows run_id 2026-04-26-autonomous-auto-ini-auto-001-1 created at 2026-04-26T09:56:46Z and containing earlier blocked/replayed summaries before the fresh campaign evidence. The closeout path then needed manual lifecycle repair because that session id had already been closed.
recommended_action: Add campaign-instance identity or a child-session uniqueness guard to autonomous-auto open-next/run-ledger integration so a fresh campaign cannot reuse a historically closed child id; campaign audits should be able to group child evidence by loop_id and campaign instance without manual filtering.

target: INI-AUTO-001 post-completion readiness and next-candidate surfaces
summary: After Green completion, route truth correctly stops on completed_or_stale_campaign, but some planning surfaces still point at the just-completed slice-auto-001-c/T-031 as the selected readiness candidate.
evidence: T-031 is complete in backlog and roadmap completed history, lifecycle-route rejects hydration and shipping because the hydrated task is already complete, and loop state records vision_realized. However INI-AUTO-001 readiness still contains next_candidate_ref: slice-auto-001-c and candidate_first_slice: slice-auto-001-c, so the human-facing planning surface can look stale even though route safety is correct.
recommended_action: Add a post-completion readiness refresh step or report field that marks the completed candidate as terminal for this campaign and either selects the next live slice, records no_safe_candidate, or requires a fresh campaign budget before surfacing it as actionable.

summary: The campaign safely stayed local because T-031 was repo-native governance/tooling work, but strategy-preflight did not explicitly state that external research was not material.
evidence: INI-AUTO-001 has external_findings: [] and T-031 acceptance was based on local artifacts such as roadmap_scaffold.py, planning_bank_validate.py, initiative-bank evidence, proposals, and tests. The autonomous-auto skill says external freshness should stop the run when material, but this campaign only implied non-materiality through local evidence rather than recording it as a first-class decision.
recommended_action: Extend strategy-preflight and campaign-audit packets with an external_freshness or external_research_materiality field such as not_material, researched, required_but_blocked, or stale; require a short rationale when no external resource is researched.

summary: The run proved async alignment can carry a campaign approval basis, but it did not prove late advisory, override, or stop packet behavior during child execution.
evidence: Loop state contains one alignment packet, align-001, of type approval_basis, with pending_count 0 and disposition applied. No later async_advisory, async_override, or async_stop packet was received or applied at a checkpoint during the research, hydration, or ship children.
recommended_action: Campaign retrospectives and UX scorecards should distinguish async_capable from async_tested. A future calibration run or test fixture should exercise advisory, override, and stop packets at safe checkpoints and record dispositions without requiring the operator to babysit sequential gates.

target: autonomous-auto staged child pipeline evidence fidelity
summary: The child pipeline had staged run-ledger evidence, but future audits should mechanically distinguish true delegated subagent execution from inline exceptions or ledger-only stage summaries.
evidence: The T-031 child records architect, planner, builder, and evaluator stage_spawns and stage_summaries in .azoth/run-ledger.local.yaml. That is useful audit scaffolding, but the durable stage rows do not carry an agent execution id, transcript reference, or explicit inline_exception flag, so a later auditor cannot tell whether the work was performed by actual staged subagents or summarized inline under an exception.
recommended_action: Extend delegated-stage evidence with execution_mode, optional agent_id/transcript_ref, and inline_exception_reason. Require require-stage-evidence or campaign-audit to flag missing execution-mode data as a residual risk for autonomous-auto campaigns that require staged delegation.

target: autonomous-auto retrospective and evaluator evidence normalization
summary: The architect retrospective produced useful Green-with-Yellow judgment, but lifecycle-report still reports evaluator evidence as not_recorded unless the retrospective is normalized into repo-native evidence inputs.
evidence: The lifecycle-report for INI-AUTO-001 reports evaluator_evidence.status not_recorded and says route quality is unscored, while the architect subagent retrospective independently found Green overall with Yellow residual design gaps. Without a normalized artifact path, later campaign audits may miss that judgment or treat it as chat-only.
recommended_action: Add a lightweight campaign-retrospective artifact or normalize architect/evaluator retrospective outputs into the campaign-audit learning/evaluator evidence path, so lifecycle reports can distinguish absent evaluator evidence from present retrospective evidence.
